scripts.wasm: cd .. && cargo build -p drape-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile release-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir app/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release-wasm/drape_web.wasm && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir app/pkg-node target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release-wasm/drape_web.wasm && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('app/pkg-node/package.json', '{\"type\": \"commonjs\"}')"
scripts.assets: cd .. && cargo build --release -p drape-native && target/release/drape export-app-assets app/public && target/release/drape export-bench-assets app/public/bench-assets
scripts.dev: npm run wasm && npm run assets && vite
scripts.build: npm run wasm && npm run assets && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.check: npm run gen:format -- --check && tsc -b && eslint . && vitest run
